title: AbelianHigherDirectImageEvaluationComparison
statement: Let $h:Y\to X$ be any morphism of schemes in universe $u$, let $U\to X$ be an object of the small etale site, and let $q\in\mathbf N$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let $B_X(U)$ be the free abelian sheaf of the represented etale object, obtained by sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Write $V=U\times_XY$ and $r:V\to Y$. The functor $F\mapsto\operatorname{Hom}_{D^+(Y_{\mathrm{et}})}((h^{-1}B_X(U))[0],F[0][q])$, with postcomposition for maps of $F$, is naturally isomorphic to $F\mapsto H^q(V,r^{-1}F[0])$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. No quasi-compactness, separation, torsion, filteredness or colimit assertion is assumed.

source.place: Tag 03Q8 (lemma-higher-direct-images), Tags 072W and 0BKV; coefficient naturality in the displayed presheaf formula.

proof.text: Use the actual RawRestrictedComparison evaluation at the pulled-back represented identity. The theorem isIso_rawRestrictedCohomologyComparisonEvaluation gives invertibility. Package the evaluation components into a natural isomorphism: on a coefficient map, T.map_comp proves that evaluation of postcomposition is postcomposition of evaluation.

Compose with the natural commShiftIso of restricted derived sections and homology shiftIso. Compose next with Plus.singleFunctorιIso and exact inverse image mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor, whiskered by derived global sections and degree-q homology. This gives precisely the displayed cohomology functor; the assembly is a composition of genuine natural isomorphisms and is implemented in Lean.

proof_origin.place: Explicit functorial form of the represented sections and sheafification comparisons; read on the Stacks website.
